reviews.shade: sungboon editor Green Tomato Deep Pore Double Cleansing Ampoule Oil 200mL
reviews.text: A very light and pleasant product, removes makeup and SPF perfectly, non-comedogenic, almost no scent, and washes off easily with water. It’s an excellent choice for oily skin that’s prone to deep, painful breakouts.
reviews.zh: 非常清爽、令人舒服嘅產品，卸妝同防曬都清得好乾淨，唔易阻塞毛孔，幾乎冇味，用水好易沖走。對於容易長深層、痛嘅暗瘡嘅油性皮膚嚟講，係非常好嘅選擇。

reviews.shade: sungboon editor Green Tomato Deep Pore Double Cleansing Ampoule Oil 200mL
reviews.text:
This cleansing oil is hands down the best oil cleanser I’ve ever used. Note that I have dry sensitive skin, and unlike other oil cleansers that feel heavy and risky for those prone the having break outs easily, this is incredibly lightweight. It melts away makeup, sunscreen, and daily build up with leaving a residue. Just because it is lightweight doesn’t mean that it wont get rid of the pesky black heads. I just have to massage it gently on my nose for it to be clear and without zero irritation.
And though it says you dont need to double cleanse, I do it anyway with another gentle/moisturizing cleanser to avoid accidentally clog my pores. But if you use it just by itself without any negative effects, more power to you. If you have been hesitant using oil cleansers cause of breakouts, i truly recommend this product.
reviews.zh:
呢款卸妝油絕對係我用過最好嘅卸妝油。注意，我係乾性敏感肌，唔似其他卸妝油咁厚身，對易生暗瘡嘅人嚟講有風險，呢款非常輕盈。佢可以溶走化妝品、防曬同日常積聚嘅污垢，又唔會留低殘膜。雖然咁輕，但係一樣可以除走令人煩嘅黑頭。我只需要喺鼻位輕輕按摩，就可以令佢清潔，而且完全冇刺激。
雖然產品話唔使雙重清潔，但我仲係會用另一款溫和／保濕嘅潔面產品再洗一次，避免不小心阻塞毛孔。不過如果你單用呢款，又冇任何負面影響，咁都好啊。如果你因為怕長暗瘡而一直唔敢用卸妝油，我真心推薦呢款產品。

reviews.shade: sungboon editor Green Tomato Deep Pore Double Cleansing Ampoule Oil 200mL
reviews.text: I thought I was going to love this oil cleanser but honestly it’s not that great. I have to use another cleanser afterwards to really clean my skin. It also feels very lightweight when applied. Don’t know if that’s a good or bad thing. I thought an oil based cleanser would be more thick. It’s an alright product.
reviews.zh: 我本來以為會好鍾意呢款卸妝油，但係老實講唔係咁好。我要再用另一款潔面產品，先至可以真正洗乾淨皮膚。塗抹嗰陣都感覺好輕，唔知係好定係唔好。我本來以為油性嘅潔面產品會厚身啲。都係一般般嘅產品。

reviews.shade: sungboon editor Green Tomato Deep Pore Double Cleansing Ampoule Oil 200mL
reviews.text:
Great oil cleanser that does not irritate my sensitive skin. 
- Slightly moisturising effect
- Reduced my nose blackheads

However I find the claim that it takes off waterproof makeup is not accurate. I use clio extreme gelpresso liner and heroine kiss me mascara which both do not come off when using this cleanser. I will say the cleanser does not irritate my eyes even when I attempt multiple times to remove my eye makeup using it, however I still use a separate waterproof makeup remover.

A great cleansing oil for my skin, just not for my waterproof eye makeup.
reviews.zh:
好好嘅卸妝油，唔會刺激我嘅敏感肌。
- 有少少保濕效果
- 令我鼻頭嘅黑頭減少咗

不過，我覺得佢宣稱可以卸走防水彩妝嘅說法唔準確。我用 clio extreme gelpresso liner 同 heroine kiss me mascara，用呢款卸妝油都卸唔走。我要講，呢款卸妝油就算我試咗幾次用佢卸眼妝，都唔會刺激眼睛，但係我仲係會另外用防水卸妝液。

對我嘅皮膚嚟講係好好嘅卸妝油，只係唔適合卸防水眼妝。

reviews.shade: sungboon editor Green Tomato Deep Pore Double Cleansing Ampoule Oil 200mL
reviews.text: Really liked this cleanser, has a nice lightweight oil texture that isn’t as thick as the Manyo cleanser and washes off my makeup really well. I feel like in comparison it feels more gentle and hydrating because I do have acne and dry skin.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款潔面產品，質地清爽似油，唔似 Manyo 嗰款咁厚身，而且卸妝效果好好。相比之下，我覺得佢比較溫和同保濕，因為我有暗瘡同乾性皮膚。

reviews.shade: sungboon editor Green Tomato Deep Pore Double Cleansing Ampoule Oil 200mL
reviews.text: Hola, soy de México. Realmente amo es aceite limpiador, me ha ayudado con el conteo de acné y limpia bien las impurezas. Recomiendo usar toda la línea de la marca para mejor resultado, es para piel sensible 💜✡️
reviews.zh: 你好，我嚟自墨西哥。我真係好鍾意呢款卸妝油，佢令我嘅暗瘡數目減少咗，清潔雜質都好好。建議用晒成個品牌嘅系列，效果會更好，佢適合敏感皮膚。💜✡️

reviews.shade: sungboon editor Green Tomato Deep Pore Double Cleansing Ampoule Oil 200mL
reviews.text: I love this pore-cleaning oil. I use it once a week and have noticed a big difference in my face. It's much smoother and feels extra clean. It's very effective in removing makeup, it saves you so much time and your face will be completely clean from all makeup residue.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款毛孔清潔油。我每個禮拜用一次，發現我面有好大嘅改善。皮膚滑好多，感覺特別乾淨。卸妝效果好好，好慳時間，皮膚會好乾淨，冇任何妝容殘留。

reviews.shade: sungboon editor Green Tomato Deep Pore Double Cleansing Ampoule Oil 200mL
reviews.text:
Effective Cleansing (4/5):
This cleansing ampoule oil excels at breaking down makeup, sunscreen, and impurities, ensuring a thorough and effective cleansing experience. The green tomato extract appears to contribute to its deep cleansing action, leaving my skin feeling refreshed.

Double Cleansing Benefits (4/5):
As part of a double cleansing routine, this ampoule oil works well to dissolve and lift away oil-based impurities, preparing the skin for a follow-up water-based cleanser. It's a crucial step in my evening skincare routine, especially after wearing makeup.

Pore Care (4/5):
The formulation's focus on deep pore care is noticeable. With consistent use, I've observed a reduction in the appearance of pores, particularly around the T-zone. The green tomato ingredient seems to lend itself well to this pore-refining effect.
reviews.zh:
清潔效果 (4/5)：
呢款清潔安瓶油擅長溶解化妝品、防曬同雜質，清潔過程徹底又有效。青番茄萃取物似乎有助深層清潔，令皮膚感覺清新。

雙重清潔效益 (4/5)：
作為雙重清潔程序嘅一部分，呢款安瓶油可以溶解並帶走油性雜質，為之後用水性潔面產品做好準備。尤其係化咗妝之後，係我晚上護膚嘅關鍵一步。

毛孔護理 (4/5)：
產品配方對深層毛孔護理嘅側重好明顯。長期使用之後，我留意到毛孔外觀有所縮減，特別係 T 字部位。青番茄成分似乎好適合呢個毛孔細緻效果。
